plan.brief:
Systematically optimize the engineering design of newspaper-crawler-py and fix real, reproducible defects on top of commit db78c68. Constraints: keep the existing Chinese CLI/help language and JSON field conventions; tests stay offline; one atomic commit per verified unit; do not push to GitHub without asking. Out of scope: rewriting the site registry, changing download semantics, or adding new newspapers.

- CLI failure contract: when crawl/plan has parsed successfully and then fails at runtime (resume with no ledger, resume with every ledger site gone, or an unexpected handler exception) under --json, stdout must be exactly one JSON object with ok=false and an error message, stderr keeps the human-readable message, the exit code stays 1, and no traceback is printed; successful JSON keeps its documented fields.
- Edition label and Markdown link integrity: an edition label must never repeat 第NN版 when a parser supplies a label-like name, and TOC link text must escape brackets so a title or edition name containing [ or ] cannot break the Markdown link; a live crawl of a real day must stay structurally unchanged.
- Legacy parser consolidation: remove the duplicated old-system article parsing in rmrb.py and gmrb.py by extracting one shared helper, prove behavior parity on both live old-system dates, and keep the full site suite green.

goals.title: CLI failure contract: when crawl/plan has parsed successfully and the...
goals.objective: CLI failure contract: when crawl/plan has parsed successfully and then fails at runtime (resume with no ledger, resume with every ledger site gone, or an unexpected handler exception) under --json, stdout must be exactly one JSON object with ok=false and an error message, stderr keeps the human-readable message, the exit code stays 1, and no traceback is printed; successful JSON keeps its documented fields.

successCriteria.scenario: With a pre-existing day file, run `python -m newspaper_crawler crawl --sites rmrb --start 2026-09-01 --end 2026-09-01 -o <tmp> --json --quiet` against a writable CRAWLER_STATE; stdout must be exactly one JSON object with ok=true and the documented keys sites/unknown_sites/start_date/end_date/output_dir/format/elapsed_secs/resumed/stats/files/skipped/errors/warnings, stats.days_skipped=1 and one skipped path.

With an empty CRAWLER_STATE, run `python -m newspaper_crawler crawl --resume --json` and `python -m newspaper_crawler plan --resume --json`; each must exit 1, write exactly one JSON object to stdout with ok=false and a non-empty error string, keep `没有可续传的任务` on stderr, and print no traceback.

In a Python harness, monkeypatch newspaper_crawler.cli.run_multi to raise RuntimeError('boom') and call main(['crawl','--sites','rmrb','--start','2026-09-01','--end','2026-09-01','-o',<tmp>,'--json','--quiet']); the return must be 1, stdout one JSON object with ok=false and an error containing 'boom', stderr a human message, and no traceback.

goals.title: Edition label and Markdown link integrity: an edition label must neve...
goals.objective: Edition label and Markdown link integrity: an edition label must never repeat 第NN版 when a parser supplies a label-like name, and TOC link text must escape brackets so a title or edition name containing [ or ] cannot break the Markdown link; a live crawl of a real day must stay structurally unchanged.

successCriteria.scenario: Call edition_label(Edition(num=1,name='第01版：要闻')), edition_label(Edition(num=1,name='第01版')), and edition_label(Edition(num=2,name='')); expect '第01版 · 要闻', '第01版', '第02版', and Formatter.markdown must contain no '第01版 · 第01版'.

Render Formatter.markdown(date, [Edition(num=1,name='要闻[特]', articles=[Article(title='标题[注]', paragraphs=['p'])])]); the TOC link text must escape both brackets (\[特\] and \[注\]) and the output must not contain the unescaped link `[标题[注]]`; headings still carry the raw title.

Run a real `crawl --sites rmzk --start 2026-11-06 --end 2026-11-06` on a fresh state; expect ok=true, 13 editions / 41 articles / 0 errors, a non-empty Markdown file whose edition labels and anchors are unique and whose labels contain no duplicated 第NN版.

goals.title: Legacy parser consolidation: remove the duplicated old-system article...
goals.objective: Legacy parser consolidation: remove the duplicated old-system article parsing in rmrb.py and gmrb.py by extracting one shared helper, prove behavior parity on both live old-system dates, and keep the full site suite green.

successCriteria.scenario: Capture the first two articles of rmrb 2024-11-30 and gmrb 2025-12-31 through each site's public fetch_article before the refactor; after the refactor capture the same fields and require title/yinti/subtitle/author/paragraphs equality for all four articles.

Parse synthetic legacy pages through both public site crawlers: a meta-description title, a title-only fallback, a missing body container, and .lai/.author selectors; each must return the expected Article and the shared helper must be the only implementation. Run the site regression suite.

Run ruff, mypy, and the repository regression suite; re-run the 8-site live audit and require every site/date OK; confirm no duplicated old-article implementation remains and the two site modules shrink.

goals.title: Site redesign must fail and stay resumable
goals.objective: When a site index is fetched but its structure is unrecognized (EmptyIndexError), record a failed, resumable day instead of a terminal empty day: the run's JSON is ok=false, the exit code is 1, and crawl --resume retries that day; a genuine no-paper day stays empty and ok.

successCriteria.scenario: Run run_site with a fake site that raises EmptyIndexError: on_day records failed, stats.days_empty=0 and stats.total_errors=1; a fake site returning [] records empty and keeps total_errors=0.

Call main(['crawl', ... '--json']) with the registry returning a site that raises EmptyIndexError: exit 1 and stdout JSON ok=false with total_errors>=1; then call main(['crawl','--resume','--json']) with the same site returning a paper and require the failed day to be retried and the resulting ledger to have no open days.
Run ruff, mypy and the repository regression suite; re-run the 8-site live audit and require every site/date OK; a genuine empty fake day still produces status empty and ok=true.
